scope.authority: Only the actual completed maintained convert/kind binder, carrying its immutable private Explicit Scalar Builtin ConversionPlan, may attach a candidate. Wrapping, dynamic payload and live matrix conversion plans are excluded. The exact scalar schemas, genuine layouts and finished request are checked again before the private final BoundCall seal.
scope.contract: Cast-only FullWrite SameAsInput0 and KernelReported, pure ReadSignal/WriteSignal with no alias. Existing arithmetic/comparison ExactScalar and operation-specific shape rules remain unchanged.
scope.integer_boundaries: U64-to-I64 rejects above i64::MAX; I64-to-U64 rejects negative. Integer-to-F64 uses correctly rounded Cranelift signed/unsigned conversion, with actual core/resident execution supplying the differential oracle, including values above2^53 and signed/unsigned maxima.
scope.floating_boundaries: F64 raw exponent rejects nonfinite values before FP truncation. Truncate toward zero, check exact representable half-open ranges [-2^63,2^63) or [0,2^64), then use the trapping signed/unsigned conversion only after the guard. Fractions in (-1,0), signed zero and subnormals legitimately become unsigned0. Failure maps to the actual resident Arithmetic boundary and exact scheduled node.
scope.transport: F64Bits raw transport accepts all input bit patterns. Nonfinite rejection belongs only to executed float-to-integer casts. I64 two's-complement and eight-byte lane representation remain unchanged.
scope.ordering: Shared JIT/Object checked emitter retains every ordered Let and its admission callback. No evaluator, placeholder, constant folding, resident fallback, source recognition or global solver relaxation is introduced.
scope.identity: Typed executable IR version4 appends op tags42-47. Existing tags and raw value encodings remain. C ABI1 and work policy1 remain because call frame/transport layout is unchanged.
scope.admission: Each new primitive explicitly uses the existing256 logical work bound, with emitted CLIF delta plus fixed64 callback bookkeeping checked during definition. Setup, memory, compiled-frame, completion and atomic output validation remain the shared managed runtime.
scope.generated_runtime: The only generator feature-list addition is maintained convert. Root runtime-only path dependency/provenance corrections are preserved. No source parser/JIT/codegen is enabled in the generated executable by this addition. Actual compiled-unit closure still requires qualification.

tests.metadata: All six casts original/decoded, actual contracts and genuine NativeHost scalar storage; same-name/public work-policy replacement cannot certify; unsupported F32, matrix, String, state and computed Activation domains remain rejected.
tests.runtime: Actual core conversion and ordinary resident execution versus JIT original/decoded, exact integer/raw floating results, nonfinite/range error classes, earlier failure before later admission, setup/completion/memory/shared-budget/type denials, unchanged outputs and recovery.
tests.object: Separate emission-only test explicitly asserts linked=false, executed=false and zero timing samples.
